Akal Takht directs Punjab government to amend anti-sacrilege law

The Akal Takht has directed the Punjab government to amend its anti-sacrilege law within one month. This directive follows a meeting with Sikh MLAs and ministers, where the Akal Takht expressed its objections to the current law. The move has sparked debate, with some experts stating that summoning elected officials by the Akal Takht is against constitutional principles.
